kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Identify auxiliary supply, sensing, communication and service circuits with their nominal and maximum voltages. Keep the traction and battery main-power paths outside this low-voltage definition.
copy.zh: 逐项识别辅助供电、传感、通信和检修回路及其标称与最高电压，将牵引和电池主动力路径与本低压范围分开定义。

copy.en: Record the controller and battery interface revisions, connector views and signal assignments. Type A and Type B BMS cables are separate pin configurations and need the correct system documentation.
copy.zh: 记录控制器与电池接口版本、接口视图及信号定义；A型与B型BMS电缆对应不同针脚配置，需要以正确的系统文件确认。

copy.en: Define CAN or other communication pairs, reference ground and shield termination from the actual interface specification. Keep high-current switching branches away from sensitive signal routes where the layout requires it.
copy.zh: 依据实际接口规范定义CAN或其他通信线对、参考地和屏蔽端接，并按布局需要隔离大电流开关分支与敏感信号路径。

copy.en: Record continuous and startup current for pumps, fans, coils and auxiliary controllers. Review conductor length, voltage drop, terminal range and circuit protection together.
copy.zh: 记录泵、风扇、线圈与辅助控制器的持续和启动电流，并一起审核导体长度、压降、端子范围与回路保护。

copy.en: Define installation zones, splash exposure, service loops and fixation points. Housing, terminal, seal, cavity plug and wire diameter must be reviewed as one interface system.
copy.zh: 定义安装区域、溅水暴露、检修余量和固定点，并把壳体、端子、密封、堵孔与线径作为一个接口系统审核。

copy.en: Approve the drawing, pin map, labels and material list before recurring builds. Check continuity and polarity, then use the agreed system-side functional test without transferring an OEM cable approval to a custom assembly.
copy.zh: 重复生产前确认图纸、针脚表、标签与物料清单，检查导通和极性后按约定进行系统侧功能验证；原厂电缆的认证不能直接转用于定制组件。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
